violations.text: The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the server station dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Technician arrived during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of pasta. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Bowls were removed; options discussed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed pasta placed hot in tightly covered plastic container. PIC removed cover to facilitate cooling and reviewed process with inspector. PIC discussed with staff. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025

Soups and sauces packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. PIC printed labels and placed on containers during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (in contact with bottles) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Ice scoop was relocated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025

Water was observed dripping in the basement under dish machine location. Per PIC, a pipe was damaged during a recent work; plumber is scheduled for service on 5/9/25. New Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2025
